common.offline: No connection. Check the network and try again.
common.timeout: The service took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
common.reloadHint: Someone else changed this record. The page now shows their version: check it and save again.

auth.signInBody: Staff and residents sign in with their phone number. New residents: activate your account first with the code from your invitation message.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
auth.codeBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {to}. It confirms that it is really you.
auth.codeExpired: The code may have expired: send a new one
auth.codeSentTo: If {phone} has an account, a 6-digit code is on its way by SMS.
auth.passwordRule: At least 10 characters; a phrase with spaces works well. Not your phone number.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.body: Your account was created when you moved in (or by your landlord). Enter the phone number from the invitation and we will send you a code.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.body: Enter your phone number and we will send you a code to choose a new password.
reset.doneBody: Every device was signed out. Sign in with the new password.

passwordIssues.CONTAINS_PHONE_NUMBER: Must not contain your phone number
passwordIssues.COMMON_PASSWORD: Too common: pick something harder to guess
passwordIssues.SAME_AS_CURRENT: Must differ from the current password

account.intro: Your sign-in details, your password and the devices signed in to your account.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

users.title: Accounts
users.intro: Staff accounts you create, and resident accounts created at move-in. New staff activate their account with a code sent to their phone.
users.createIntro: The person receives an SMS invitation and activates the account with a code. Choose what they do and where.
users.name: Full name

roleHints.LANDLORD: Everything, in every building of the account
roleHints.ACCOUNTANT: Invoices, payments, deposits, tax; reads the rest
roleHints.GUARD: Meter round and the room list

users.otherBuildings: Also has access to {n} building(s) you don't manage; those stay as they are.
users.disabled: Account disabled: every device was signed out
users.disableNote: A disabled account cannot sign in; every device is signed out at once.
users.disabledNote: This account is disabled and cannot sign in.
users.tenantNote: Resident accounts are created when the person moves in and follow their contract. Here you can only enable or disable them.

dashboard.introStaff: Today's figures for the building you are working on.
